attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "This removes public API members (ShapeMetadata.BindingSources, ShapeDescriptor.BindingSources, virtual overrides on Binding/BindingSource/Placement) and seals FeatureShapeDescriptor/ShapeDescriptorIndex/ShapeBinding, which is a breaking change for any theme or module that reads BindingSources for localization scoping or subclasses these display types."

{"risk": 4, "reason": "Removes public BindingSources APIs (ShapeMetadata.BindingSources, ShapeDescriptor.BindingSources) used for localization scoping and seals several previously-extensible display classes (FeatureShapeDescriptor, ShapeBinding, ShapeDescriptorIndex), which can break themes/modules that relied on these APIs or subclassed them, even though the changes are documented as breaking in the 3.0.0 release notes."}

reason: Removes public BindingSources APIs (ShapeMetadata.BindingSources, ShapeDescriptor.BindingSources) used for localization scoping and seals several previously-extensible display classes (FeatureShapeDescriptor, ShapeBinding, ShapeDescriptorIndex), which can break themes/modules that relied on these APIs or subclassed them, even though the changes are documented as breaking in the 3.0.0 release notes
